en: Color postcard showing a stone castle barbican with high rough masonry walls, a wooden staircase leading up along the right tower, and a cobbled courtyard. In the background is a building with a light-colored plastered façade and a steep hipped roof with a small spire. The reverse side has multilingual printed text identifying the place, publisher details, price, address lines, and stamp boxes.
